source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Whenever this model picks an enemy unit as a target for its heavy death ray, the opposing player must choose one of two responses for that unit:

- Stand firm: for the rest of this phase, ranged attacks that target that unit score a **Critical Hit** on an unmodified 5+ to hit.
- Duck for cover: until your next [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) begins, subtract 1 from **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** for attacks made by models in that unit.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.trigger: each instance of targeting an enemy unit with heavy death ray

stand firm.attacks: ranged attacks against chosen enemy unit

duck for cover.duration: until start of controller next Shooting phase
